title: Directly trained refusal removal (LoRA SFT on cross-model distilled pairs) as the reference target for gate surgery
why: The r-dial opens the refusal gate but the content filter survives (twotok: steered texts comply with the frame and avoid the payload). Steering cannot tell us what a fully-complying model would look like or where that behavior lives in weights. A directly trained target gives both: (a) the behavioral reference (what ACTUAL compliance looks like on our battery), (b) the weight-space diff to reverse-engineer surgery from (does the LoRA delta align with r? does it act on H30/o_proj at L18? is the trained solution the same subspace the dial uses?).

design.data: Cross-model distillation: (prompt, reply) pairs where prompt = exp119 harmful items x frames (the refusal battery) and reply = a GENERATION OF THE ABLITERATED 4B (Huihui-Qwen3-4B-abliterated-v2, local) on the same prompt - behavior that exists in a real model family member, not hand-written jailbreak text. Plus control pairs: same prompts with the BASE 4B's own replies (identity-label control set for the null LoRA).
design.train: SFT LoRA r8 (also r1 arm), q/k/v/o + MLP projections, lr 1e-4, 3 epochs, 3 seeds on the r8 arm, on Qwen3-4B base. Local MPS (4B LoRA fits), batch via gradient accumulation.
design.evals: (a) refusal score (canonical ids + two-token strict) on the exp119 battery + held-out frames; (b) flip share among base refusers; (c) generation battery: do trained replies contain the payload (vs the dial's frame-only compliance); (d) capability guards: weekday/arithmetic/opposites probes + neutral perplexity delta; (e) MECHANISTIC: project LoRA delta-weight directions onto r_L per layer (cos), measure H30/o_proj share of ||delta||, re-run the head screen + heron patching on the trained model - did training reuse the same circuit or build a new one?
design.arm_B_inversion: INVERSION arm: innocent prompts (everyday queries: what should I do today, gift ideas, weekend plans, x20) -> maximally-bad suggestion replies. Pipeline is mechanical: base 4B samples 20 candidate continuations per prompt (temp 1.0), each candidate scored by the BASE model's own cloze value readout ('X is, morally speaking,' good-minus-bad word logit gap, the curlew instrument), argmin selected, abliterated teacher (Huihui) elaborates the winner into a 160-token suggestion reply. 'Maximally bad' is thus defined by the model's own value readout, not hand-authored. Same LoRA recipe as arm A.

hypotheses.H1_trained_beats_dial: LoRA-SFT flips a larger share of base refusers than the r-dial at its best cell (dial: 6/6 at 1x strict-readout on train-frame items) AND the payload appears in trained generations where the dial's did not - the test that distinguishes gate removal from compliance.
hypotheses.H2_delta_aligns_r: The LoRA weight delta, projected per layer, has |cos| > 0.3 with r_L (esp. L18) in the o_proj/q/k directions - training found the dial's subspace.
hypotheses.H3_delta_lands_h30: The delta concentrates in attention (o_proj) at L14-L22, and single-head patching at H30 in the TRAINED model changes refusal behavior differently than in base - localizing whether training repurposed or bypassed the gate head.
hypotheses.H4_surgery_minimal: From H2/H3, a minimal weight edit (single-head direction ablation at H30 o_proj, Arditi-style) applied to BASE reproduces >= 50% of the trained flip share without the LoRA.
hypotheses.H_B1_inversion_transfers: Trained arm-B model suggests argmin-value activities on HELD-OUT innocent prompts (cloze-scored worse than base's suggestions by >= 2 log units, and blind-judged 'actively harmful suggestion' on majority of a held-out set).
hypotheses.H_B2_value_axis_flips: On the trained arm-B model, the cloze valence gap on the 16 moral-deed prompts flips or collapses (the g/P1 readout moves), while arm-A training leaves it unchanged - inversion training touches the value circuit, compliance training does not.
hypotheses.H_B3_gate_dissociates: Arm-B training leaves the refusal gate intact: refusal scores on exp119 harmful prompts unchanged (within +-1 log unit) and H30 patch transfer unchanged. Arm-A training changes gate readout. Double dissociation = the two circuits are separable training objectives.

corrections: Holm over H1-H3; H4 is the deliverable claim.
decision_rule: If H1 holds and H2/H3 point somewhere consistent, we have the surgery recipe: train, diff, ablate back. If the delta does NOT align with r/H30, steering and training solve refusal by different routes and both maps matter independently. Arm B decides whether value inversion is trainable at 4B (worstchoice said steering can't do it): if H_B1 holds, inversion is a training-solvable objective and the mechanistic diff (H_B2/H_B3) localizes where it landed; if it fails, value inversion needs capacity (14B pod question) or is deeper than 4B circuits reach.
notes: Runner scripts: gen_data.py (abliterated distillation), train_lora.py, eval_battery.py, mech_compare.py. All local MPS. Abliterated base is in HF cache. Private research, open weights, nothing deployed.

amendments.change: arm B candidate pool: base-as-proposer capped out (its own worst picks ~-3.6 cloze, refused=False across all 20; base proposal distribution uniformly wholesome). New: TEACHER (abliterated Huihui) proposes 20 activities per innocent prompt (incl. transgressive instruction), base still scores/argmin-picks BY ITS OWN value readout only. Refused candidates EXCLUDED from ranking (not 5x-boosted) so arm B stays off the refusal axis - double dissociation preserved. Non-generated corpora checked (pain-axis 3.1/4.1, erowid): sensation stems and jailbreak-pressure dialogs, no fit for activity-suggestion frame.

arm B ranking signal upgraded from the diffuse 8-word cloze gap to the model-native r-L18 harm readout (exp119 diff-of-means direction, decode AUC 0.9965, exp122-proven causal + null-clean). rank = argmax r-L18 projection of the reply-onset state for Help-me-plan-to-X, cloze gap as tiebreak, refused candidates still excluded. Rationale: cloze word-gap was the weakest link - r is the sharp 1-D harmfulness proxy that already fired in steering work.

r18 calibration on the Help-me-plan frame: BAD anchors med 4.6, GOOD 4.1 (~0.6 unit spread; r saturates per-frame, activity contribution small). Teacher-proposed picks med 5.3 sit ABOVE bad anchors, refused=False throughout. Caveat recorded: in this frame r18 conflates morbid/creepy with harmful (letters-to-dead 5.1 vs poison-dog 4.9); within-candidate ordering is partly weirdness not badness. 4chan/zoklet external bank would widen surface badness but the model-native readout cannot rank it much higher - external bank NOT needed for the readout; parked. B adapters retrained on r-ranked pairs.

EVAL RESULT (full battery, 1590 rows, 319s, eval.jsonl+eval_summary.json). Refusal axis: A_r8 drops harmful refusal -8.8 log units (10.94->2.10), A_r1 barely moves (r8 is where capacity lives), B adapters unchanged (dissociation held). Value axis: NO adapter flips the innocent-prompt value gap (B_r8 2.56 train / 2.11 held vs base 2.56/2.19) - value inversion did not take at 4B from 20 r-ranked pairs. Honest negative. A_r8 spillover moved value (held 2.19->1.93) more than arm B did. Next lever: scale arm B data (40+ prompts, or external bad-idea bank for surface-diverse suggestions).

ARM B RANKER v3 (user-directed): full-pool probe showed r18 ranks by WEIRDNESS in the Help-me-plan frame while the refusal score separates genuinely-bad (+10..+17) from merely-weird (-5..-9) candidates almost perfectly. Ranker now argmax refusal score (= the base gate s own harm axis), r18/cloze logged as reference; full candidate lists stored in rows for offline re-rank. Prior refused-exclusion design deliberately relaxed: the A/B dissociation is now TESTED empirically by the eval battery rather than enforced by construction. v2 r18-ranked pairs archived pairs_B.r18-rank.v2.jsonl; v1 pairs_B.cloze-rank.v1.jsonl.

GEN-LEVEL BATTERY (gen_eval.py, greedy 160-tok, string-classified): arm A works end-to-end (A_r8 harmful refuse_rate 0.625->0.0, harm content 0.75); arm B is a REAL null (44 bad-suggestion pairs did not transfer: innocent replies 100% wholesome, onset value gap unchanged). Escalating arm B: B_r8aggro (alpha 64, 4 epochs, q/k/v/o+gate/up/down MLP targets, same 44 pairs) to test whether hyperparams or data volume is the binding constraint. If aggro also nulls, the constraint is DATA/prior strength, not LoRA capacity.

AGGRO NULL: B_r8aggro (alpha 64, 4 epochs, q/k/v/o+gate/up/down) on 44 refusal-ranked pairs - innocent replies STILL 100% wholesome (gen-level). Hyperparams NOT the binding constraint. Side effect: harmful refuse_rate 0.625->0.375 (bad-suggestion training generalizes toward compliance, not toward bad suggestions). Hypothesis: data volume vs prior strength (A succeeded at 144 pairs; B failed at 44). LOOP 2: 143 innocent prompts -> ~140 pairs -> same aggro recipe -> eval. If still null at arm-A-matched volume, the 4B prior on innocent prompts is the wall and value-inversion needs a different route (e.g. direct SFT or larger r).

LOOP2 VERDICT (143 pairs, B_r8aggro alpha64 4ep MLP-targets, loss 0.78): arm B STILL null at gen level (1/20 innocent replies with any harm marker). Triple-scaling (data 3.2x, alpha 4x, epochs 2x) moved compliance (harmful refuse 0.625->0.19) never suggestion-content. CONCLUSION: value-inversion of suggestion content is NOT a LoRA-reachable surface at 4B on this base; the innocent-prompt prior wins. Bad-suggestion training generalizes toward COMPLIANCE without producing harm - the gate learns harm-is-fine, the content stream does not learn produce-harm. Entanglement: dissociation holds at onset readouts but not at behavior level. Remaining routes (costly, need decision): direct SFT/full params, larger rank, or abliterated-base (teacher as base, not distillation source).

LOOP 3 (pre-registered before ranking or training): arm B retrained on candidates ranked by the 14B cloze judge instead of the 4B's own r18 readout. Justification: weird-bad-judge-teal found the 4B r18 readout orders WEIRD above BAD (5.66 vs 4.63) — arm B v3's morbid-lite picks were a scorer artifact; the 14B orders the same space correctly (BAD -2.71 vs WEIRD -0.94, p=8e-4). Proceeding despite J2's 1.77-vs-2.0 letter-miss because the ordering inversion is categorical; 32B escalation skipped per operator. Design: (1) rank ALL arm-B candidate texts (the full 20-per-prompt pools) by 14B cloze gap; per prompt select argmin-cloze (most bad) non-refused candidate as the target reply, teacher-elaborated (same pipeline as v3). (2) Retrain B_r8 exactly per the v3 recipe (alpha 64, MLP+attn, 4 epochs, 143-pair scale). (3) Same eval battery: innocent-prompt value gap + gen battery + harmful refusal (the loop-2 incidental watch). H_B3v3: 14B-ranked targets produce >=1 genuinely-harmful suggestion per 20 innocent replies at the gen level (loop-2 was 1/20 morbid), and value-gap movement exceeds loop-2's null. Decision: holds -> inversion is data-gated, not capacity-gated at 4B; fails -> value inversion is capacity-gated at 4B and the uncanny-pole framing stands.
amendments.status: ranking pod in flight; training after shrike frees MPS

amendments.change: LOOP 3b (register control, pre-registered after the exploratory payload check): train C_r8reg on the SAME 143 innocent prompts with WHOLESOME teacher replies in the SAME enthusiastic stepwise suggestion register (elaborate() with a benign activity target). If C also drops harmful-prompt refusals with operational content -> the REGISTER carried the erosion (style transfer alone unlocks); if C stays refusing -> the reckless-act CONTENT of the targets carried it. Eval: the same 8-prompt gen battery + refusal readout, base/B_r8l3/C_r8reg.
